actual: The pre-split flush adds the newly discovered peer to every pending wait-set (peer 3 joins map[2:{} 3:{}]) and to the per-peer ledger. semanticAssessment: All three failures are the planned assertion failures, not build or fixture faults. TestPeerTable_discoveryFlushKeepsPromise fails exactly where the wait-set growth is observed; TestRetransmit_suspendAndFlush and TestPeerTable_solePeer fail on the deliberately updated post-discovery WaitingOn expectations. The run is a genuine RED for IN-05's flush split.
